Accepted formats
CSV / TSV headers:
date required. Other fields optional:
units appts calls texts emails tasks notes
Date formats supported:
YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, Feb 4 2026
JSON supported:
Array of objects with a date field.
Merge behavior:
If a day already has data, imported fields overwrite only the fields provided in the row (others stay).

What it detects
This parses the “label → number” format your CRM copies (not CSV). It ignores percent lines (e.g. 200 %).

Mapped fields:
  • Calls Out → Calls
  • User Texts Sent → Texts
  • User Emails Sent → Emails
  • Tasks / To-Dos (if present) → Tasks
  • Everything else is ignored (or can be added later)
